title: The Hop Walk - Nashville Guided Brewery Walking Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Unlike a typical brewery hop, the Hop Walk centers on Germantown's story — one of Nashville's oldest, most historic neighborhoods. Your guide, a friendly Nashville local, brings the area's Prohibition-era past and its rise as a brewery hub to life with every pour.

The pay-as-you-go format sets this tour apart from guided experiences that lock you into drink packages. You decide what to order and how much — a hazy IPA, a seltzer, a glass of wine, or nothing at all. Cocktails and N/A options are available too, so it works for beer fans and non-drinkers alike.

The route itself is part of the draw. Over one mile, guests visit three distinct Germantown landmarks — from Bearded Iris Brewing's Greenway-side taproom to Monday Night Brewing's home inside the historic Neuhoff meatpacking site, ending near the Sounds ballpark at Tailgate Brewery. It's a walkable mix of local flavor, craft beer, and neighborhood history.

Dogs and kids 12+ are welcome on this tour!
